Mechanical Engineer roles available within SQS Group in all states, work assignment may either be in NSW, QLD, SA, VIC, or WA

Southern Steel Group and its subsidiaries specialise in providing the nest steel products, sheet & coil, and expert steel processing and distribution. Our company network is extensive, represented in every Australian state.

Southern Queensland Steel is part of the Southern Steel Group, the largest privately-owned steel company in Australia. With more than 1400 employees nationwide, the foundations of this company are built on strong values and a sense of family belonging.

We service our customers through multiple SQS businesses and division affiliates in various States in Australia. In NSW: Steelpipes, Piling Solutions Australia, Rigby Jones, Rollco, Metal Shop Technics, Southern Sheet & Coil, Coil Processors. In QLD: RPG Australia. In Victoria: Surdex Steel, Smithweld Bending, KOMO Metform Engineering, Alliance Laser, Surdex Sheet & Coil, Eliott Engineering, Australian Rollforming Manufacturers. In SA: Brice Metals, Ferrocut. In WA: WA Cutting Services, Boyd Metal Industries

To succeed in this position, you will need to have industry related experience within similar positions, a strong work ethic and strong safety focus.

The ability to carry out work with minimal supervision, a keen and enthusiastic approach to your work and willingness to work over time will help you ensure success in this role.

MAIN OBJECTIVE
Responsible for managing engineering and production processes of jobs from quoting stage to completion, including planning, scheduling, NC programming, purchasing, follow up, liaising with customers, suppliers and coordinating with other team members during entire production process.

DUTIES
Review quotation and purchase order information (provide assistance to Estimator during quotation process if required). Enter sales order and set up jobs in ERP system. Update job information in relevant customer folder.
Process CAD information using AUTOCAD to put through FAST CAM package to generate NC Programs to relevant machines. Convert 3D drawings to 2D if relevant.
Calculate material required and check availability of stock (obtain quote & source material if necessary).
Keep system job entries up-to-date. Transfer relevant NC programs to machines. Issue Job Card to Workshop.
Constantly follow progress of jobs, check engineering, tooling and quality. Ensure completed job complies with customer requirements. Liaise with customers regarding job completion and delivery status.
Coordinate with Accounts and Production Manager to ensure jobs are shipped and invoiced upon completion.
Conduct job analysis on time, cost, quality and materials. Make any changes/improvements as required for future jobs.
Liaise with other team members regarding current jobs, quoted/potential jobs, production issues relating to machines, operators, material etc.
Other indirect tasks as directed by Manager including: coordinating IT services with HO; changing crystal report in Ml to suit our application; suggest Improvements/streamline processes; provide customer information to team members to assist with obtaining future work.
All employees are subject to legal obligations regarding their own and their fellow workers Work Health & Safety (WH&S). They are to fully co-operate with the company WH&S Policy and Program, to ensure safety in the workplace is maintained. All employees shall undertake hazard identification as part of their normal duties, and report any unsafe conditions or work practices. All employees are responsible for their own safety as well as those around them.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED
Sound knowledge, understanding and interpretation of engineering drawings
Knowledge and experience in cutting and forming processes
Meticulous — eye for detail
Understand and utilise computer technology (AUTOCAD / FASTCAM)
Excellent communication skills
Strong work ethic and values team work

The successful applicant will be joining a secure, reputable organisation who o er their employees’ opportunities for career progression.
If you have the skills & experience we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.

Note: Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. We promote a safe work culture; therefore, we have a process of reference checking and pre-employment medicals which includes a drug and alcohol screen for the successful applicant.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Location: Balaklava, SA, 5461
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Aged Care Facility Manager
Job Title: Residential Care Officer
Salary range: $79,500 - $85,000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client, an independent, not-for-profit aged care provider known as “the heart of country care,” we are seeking a dedicated Residential Care Officer. Our client proudly supports older South Australians in regional communities with safe, caring and inclusive living environments across residential aged care and retirement living. They are passionate about developing respectful, warm and genuine relationships where everyone is valued and everyone matters. We are looking for a Residential Care Officer who will help deliver quality care through mutual respect, empowering residents to make choices about their life, support and care.

Key Duties (paraphrased & detailed)
Documentation & Care Planning
• Maintain accurate, current resident documentation including daily progress notes, thorough care assessments, and individualised care plans that reflect each resident’s preferences and needs.
• Monitor and record any changes in residents’ physical, emotional, or cognitive condition, promptly reporting concerns to clinical staff to enable timely interventions.

Personal Care & Independence Support
• Encourage residents’ independence by respectfully assisting with personal care tasks (bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting) strictly in line with their care plan.
• Provide consistently high standards of care and support, helping residents maintain dignity and choice in all aspects of daily living.

Household & Environmental Duties
• Make residents’ beds, ensure fresh clean linen is always available, and keep residents’ clothing stored neatly and organised.
• Correctly return laundered clothing to appropriate residents’ rooms, maintaining a clean, safe, and homely environment.

Meal & Nursing Assistance
• Assist with meal service, supporting residents during mealtimes with feeding, hydration, and social engagement as required.
• Help deliver specialised nursing care under supervision (e.g., medication prompts, mobility assistance, wound care support), following individual care plans.

Communication, Rights & Emotional Support
• Communicate effectively with colleagues, residents, families, GPs, and allied health professionals to ensure prompt, courteous, and coordinated service delivery.
• Uphold residents’ rights to privacy, confidentiality, choice, and decision-making always, and offer genuine emotional support and companionship.

Teamwork, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
• Engage proactively as part of the wider care team, building positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support compliance with Aged Care Quality Standards and company policies; attend team meetings, training sessions, and identify personal learning needs.
• Contribute to workplace safety initiatives, recognise and report potential risks or complaints, and follow all OH&S policies.
• Adhere to relevant legislation, demonstrate EEO principles, and champion organisational policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience Required
• Minimum 1 year full-time relevant experience in aged care or disability support.
• Diploma or relevant qualification in Individual Support, Community Services, or Aged Care.
• Satisfactory police check; valid driver’s licence and own reliable transport.
• Up-to-date annual flu vaccination and full COVID-19 immunisation.
• Signed statutory declaration disclosing any serious overseas criminal history (if applicable).
• Current NDIS Worker Screening Clearance (within 5 years) – preferable.
• Genuine team player with a commitment to long-term employment in a regional community setting.

Why Join?
Rewarding work making a real difference in seniors’ lives, ongoing training and professional development, supportive team culture with regular staff recognition, modern country facilities, and career growth potential within a respected not-for-profit organisation.

How to Apply
Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your experience and why you would be perfect for this role. Successful applicants must comply with Aged Care Quality Standards and complete orientation training.

We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

About Our Client
Our client is an award-winning luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant landmark where modern sophistication meets unparalleled service. They are celebrated for creating immersive, memorable experiences for their guests, from the elegance of their accommodations to the dynamic energy of their world-class dining and entertainment precinct. The culinary philosophy is centred on contemporary, produce-driven cuisine, showcasing the finest local and seasonal ingredients with artistry and precision. They are seeking a passionate and skilled Chef de Partie to join their exceptional culinary brigade.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a dedicated Chef de Partie to become an integral part of their high-energy kitchen team. This is not just a job; it's an opportunity to contribute to a culinary landscape known for its innovation and excellence. You will be responsible for managing a specific section of the kitchen, ensuring every dish that leaves your station meets the impeccable standards expected by their discerning guests. You will play a key role in bringing their celebrated menus to life, working with premium ingredients in a fast-paced, professional, and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
Menu Development & Kitchen Management
• Collaborate with the Senior Chef team in the creative process of researching, developing, and costing new menu items that align with the hotel's contemporary and seasonal culinary direction.
• Manage the efficient ordering and organisation of high-quality food supplies for your section, minimising waste while maintaining the highest standards of ingredient quality.
• Assist in calculating detailed food and labour costs for your designated kitchen section to ensure financial targets and budgetary guidelines are consistently met.

Culinary Execution & Quality Control
• Expertly prepare, cook, and present a diverse range of dishes to the exact specification of the Head Chef, demonstrating advanced technical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• Meticulously monitor the quality, flavour, and visual presentation of all dishes at every stage, from initial mise en place to final plating, ensuring consistency and excellence.
• Take ownership of your section during service periods, demonstrating leadership, organisation, and the ability to perform under pressure to deliver a seamless dining experience.

Leadership, Training & Hygiene Standards
• Proactively participate in the training and development of Commis Chefs and apprentices, mentoring them in classic and modern cooking techniques and procedures.
• Uphold and rigorously enforce the company’s comprehensive health, safety, and hygiene regulations, including HACCP protocols, to ensure a pristine and safe working environment at all times.
• Foster clear and effective communication by discussing daily preparation, potential challenges, and special dietary requirements with Managers, Sous Chefs, and service staff.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Proven experience as a Chef de Partie or Demi Chef de Partie within a high-volume, à la carte or fine-dining kitchen environment.
• A formal qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or equivalent) is highly regarded.
• A genuine passion for contemporary, produce-driven cuisine and a commitment to culinary excellence.
• Demonstrated ability to manage a section, lead by example, and support junior team members.
• Comprehensive knowledge of kitchen operations, including but not limited to butchery, seafood preparation, and sauce work.
• An unwavering commitment to maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and food safety.
• Excellent communication skills, a positive and collaborative team spirit, and the ability to thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment.
• Flexibility to work across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

If you are a culinary professional ready to take the next step in your career within a celebrated and dynamic hotel environment, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience via the link below.

## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
